title: Libre sensor "wait 60 minutes" on already running sensor
symptom: Users report that when starting an already-running Libre 2/2+ sensor in xDrip+ (e.g., after scanning with NFC and selecting "Not today"), xDrip+ displays a "wait 60 minutes" warmup message and delays calibration and data transmission to AAPS, even though the sensor has been running for days.
cause: The thread identifies that a code change introduced between nightly builds 2025.03.12 and 2025.03.23 caused this behavior, but the exact root cause is not fully established. It is suspected to relate to overlapping backfills or the handling of sensor start times.
fix: A fix was attempted via PR #4253 and released in the 2025.11.28 Nightly, but the issue persisted for some users. Later, it was reported as resolved (not persisting beyond once on a new installation) and the issue was closed. The thread does not specify a precise configuration change.
evidence_quote: I just updated to 2025.12.02 as I saw Libre mentioned in the changelog. Stopped the sensor in xDrip+, NFC scanned, did "Start sensor", said "Not today" and went to "Please wait while sensor warms up! (60 minutes) status.
